mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII AI assist request metadata. INSERT INTO ai_assist_requests ( id, assist_type_code, resource_type, resource_id, input_hash_sha256, input_length, requested_by, status_code, provider_code, model_code, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{assistTypeCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{inputHashSha256}, #{inputLength}, #{requestedBy}, #{statusCode}, #{providerCode}, #{modelCode}, CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'COMPLETED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END )

-- Insert AI assist draft result for operator review. INSERT INTO ai_assist_results ( id, request_id, result_text, review_status_code, prompt_token_count, completion_token_count, latency_ms, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{requestId}, #{resultText}, #{reviewStatusCode}, #{promptTokenCount}, #{completionTokenCount}, #{latencyMs}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
mapper.select:
-- Select AI assist request list. SELECT ar.id AS request_id, air.id AS result_id, ar.assist_type_code, ar.resource_type, ar.resource_id, ar.status_code AS request_status_code, ar.provider_code, ar.model_code, air.review_status_code, air.result_text, ar.requested_by, ar.created_at, ar.completed_at FROM ai_assist_requests ar JOIN ai_assist_results air ON air.request_id = ar.id
ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC, ar.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count AI assist requests. SELECT count(1) FROM ai_assist_requests ar JOIN ai_assist_results air ON air.request_id = ar.id

-- Select one AI assist request. SELECT ar.id AS request_id, air.id AS result_id, ar.assist_type_code, ar.resource_type, ar.resource_id, ar.status_code AS request_status_code, ar.provider_code, ar.model_code, air.review_status_code, air.result_text, ar.requested_by, ar.created_at, ar.completed_at FROM ai_assist_requests ar JOIN ai_assist_results air ON air.request_id = ar.id WHERE ar.id = #{requestId}

-- Select one AI assist request by result id. SELECT ar.id AS request_id, air.id AS result_id, ar.assist_type_code, ar.resource_type, ar.resource_id, ar.status_code AS request_status_code, ar.provider_code, ar.model_code, air.review_status_code, air.result_text, ar.requested_by, ar.created_at, ar.completed_at FROM ai_assist_requests ar JOIN ai_assist_results air ON air.request_id = ar.id WHERE air.id = #{resultId}
mapper.update: -- Update operator review status for AI assist result. UPDATE ai_assist_results SET review_status_code = #{reviewStatusCode}, reviewed_by = #{actorUserId}, reviewed_at = now() WHERE id = #{resultId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert non-PII AI assist audit log. INSERT INTO audit_logs ( actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json ) VALUES ( #{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
